name: Residential Mortgage Application — Happy Path
description: End-to-end happy path sequence for a personal customer (PER-001) applying for a residential mortgage. Covers PH-009 through PH-015: enquiry, DIP (automated, < 15 minutes), full application, valuation, underwriting approval, offer acceptance, and completion with CHAPS funds release. Shows synchronous and async event flows across SVC-002, SVC-001 (same capability), SVC-012 and SVC-014 (cross-capability via event bus).

steps.label: Enter property details, deposit, income, product selection
POST /mortgage-applications
steps.request_body: customer_id, property_address, purchase_price, deposit_amount, term_years, rate_type, product_id, application_type, gross_income

steps.label: GET /customers/{customer_id}
steps.note: Same-capability direct call — fetch customer identity data for ESIS

steps.label: 200 Customer data (name, address, DOB)
Create ENT-012 MortgageApplication (status: enquiry). Run affordability pre-check.
Publish EVT-020 MortgageEnquiryStarted
steps.note: SVC-014 subscribes — checks if customer KYC is current

steps.label: 201 MortgageApplication created (application_id, affordability pre-check result)
Display affordability result. Prompt: proceed to DIP?
Consume EVT-020 MortgageEnquiryStarted
steps.note: SVC-014 checks existing KYC record. Customer is existing bank customer — KYC current. Publishes EVT-004 KYCClearanceGranted.

steps.label: Publish EVT-004 KYCClearanceGranted (reuse existing KYC)
Submit income/employment details. Consent to soft credit check.
POST /mortgage-applications/{id}/dip
steps.request_body: employment_status, gross_income, net_income, committed_expenditure, soft_credit_check_consent: true

steps.label: Create ENT-013 AffordabilityAssessment (stage: dip). Compute stress test. Transition application status: dip_pending.
Publish EVT-022 CreditCheckRequested (check_type: soft, application_id, customer_id)
202 Accepted (status: dip_pending, polling_url)
Consume EVT-022 CreditCheckRequested (soft)
Call credit bureau (soft check — no footprint). Receive credit score and risk indicators.
Publish EVT-023 CreditCheckCompleted (check_type: soft, credit_score: 720, outcome: pass)
Consume EVT-023 CreditCheckCompleted
Credit check pass. Affordability check pass. Create MortgageOffer record not yet — create DIP record. Transition status: dip_issued. Set dip_date, dip_expiry (+90 days).
Publish EVT-021 DIPIssued (application_id, dip_date, dip_expiry, indicative_loan_amount)
Consume EVT-021 DIPIssued. Send DIP certificate email to customer with ESIS document.
Email: DIP approved — certificate attached. Valid 90 days.
Submit full application. Upload payslips, P60, bank statements. Consent to hard credit check.
POST /mortgage-applications/{id}/full-application
Create ENT-013 AffordabilityAssessment (stage: full_application). Transition status: full_application_submitted. Set full_application_date.
Publish EVT-022 CreditCheckRequested (check_type: hard, application_id, customer_id)
202 Accepted (status: full_application_submitted)
Consume EVT-022 CreditCheckRequested (hard)
Call credit bureau (hard check — footprint recorded). Full credit report retrieved.
Publish EVT-023 CreditCheckCompleted (check_type: hard, credit_score: 715, outcome: pass, report_reference)
Consume EVT-023 CreditCheckCompleted. Update application. Transition status: documents_complete.
Determine valuation type: LTV 75% → desktop AVM. Create ENT-014 PropertyValuation (status: instructed). Transition application status: valuation_pending.
Publish EVT-024 ValuationInstructed (application_id, valuation_id, property_address, valuation_type: desktop)
Instruct AVM valuation via surveyor panel API (for desktop: automated)
steps.note: For desktop AVM: automated. For drive-by/full: instruction sent to surveyor panel.

steps.label: Valuation report: valuation_amount = £385,000 (purchase price £390,000 — within tolerance for LTV)

Update ENT-014 PropertyValuation (status: completed, valuation_amount: 385000, down_valuation_flag: false). Recalculate LTV on ENT-012: 292500/385000 = 75.97%. Transition application status: valuation_complete.
Publish EVT-025 ValuationCompleted (application_id, valuation_amount: 385000, down_valuation_flag: false)
Assign to underwriting queue. Transition application status: underwriting. PER-055 assigned.

PER-055 reviews full application pack: credit report, affordability assessment, income docs, valuation. LTI ratio = 3.8x (within 4.5x cap). Affordability: pass at stress rate 7%. LTV: 75.97% — within product limit. Decision: APPROVE.
Publish EVT-026 MortgageUnderwritingCompleted (application_id, decision: approved, underwriter_id: PER-055)

Create ENT-015 MortgageOffer (offered_amount: 292500, offered_rate: 4.89%, term: 25 years, offer_date: today, expiry_date: today+6months, conditions: ['Buildings insurance required at completion']). Transition application status: offer_issued.
Publish EVT-027 MortgageOfferIssued (application_id, offer_id, offered_amount, offered_rate, offer_date, expiry_date)
Consume EVT-027. Send mortgage offer document to customer (email + post) and solicitor.
Email + post: Mortgage Offer issued. 7-day reflection period starts today.
Email: Mortgage Offer copy to solicitor.
7-day reflection period elapses (MCOB 6.7). Customer reviews offer with solicitor.
Accept mortgage offer (after 7-day reflection period)
POST /mortgage-applications/{id}/offer
Validate: accepted_date >= offer_date + 7 days. Update ENT-015 (customer_accepted: true, accepted_date). Transition application status: offer_accepted.
Publish EVT-028 MortgageOfferAccepted (application_id, offer_id, accepted_date)
Solicitor completes conveyancing, Land Registry searches, exchange of contracts.
Requisition for funds: completion_date, CHAPS account details
CHAPS payment instruction: release mortgage funds to solicitor (£292,500)
CHAPS settlement confirmed (irrevocable). chaps_payment_reference returned.
POST /mortgage-accounts (internal completion processing)

Create ENT-016 MortgageAccount (outstanding_balance: 292500, monthly_payment: 1683.42, rate: 4.89%, term_remaining: 300 months, status: active). Set up Bacs direct debit mandate. Transition application status: completed.
Publish EVT-029 MortgageCompleted (application_id, customer_id, completion_date, chaps_reference)
Publish EVT-030 MortgageAccountOpened (account_id, customer_id, mortgage_offer_id, outstanding_balance, monthly_payment)
Consume EVT-030. Update Customer product holdings record to include new mortgage account.
Consume EVT-030. Dispatch mortgage welcome pack to customer.
Email + post: Mortgage account open. Account details, monthly payment schedule, first payment date, direct debit confirmation.
